text: The cool glass and empty chairs evoke a sense of quiet anticipation in me. The slanted perspective lends a slightly disorienting feeling, as if I am caught between moments of action and stillness. The presence of safety equipment grounds me in the practical reality of the space, yet the transparency of the walls hints at openness and collaboration. I feel curious, yet a bit of existential uncertainty as I stand in this threshold between private contemplation and potential connection.
